{{Disambig|Skeleton}}

==Enemies==
'''Skeleton''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Cursed Skeleton]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 23 in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]
**[[Cursed Skeleton/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Fallen Skeleton]], an enemy that is spawned by the [[Fallen Necromancer]] in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, that first appears on Wave 10 in [[Badlands II]]
**[[Fallen Skeleton/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Giant Skeleton]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 15 in [[Badlands II]]
**[[Giant Skeleton/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Necrotic Skeleton]], an enemy that is spawned by the [[Fallen Summoner]] and [[Fallen King]] in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode, that first appears on Wave 22 in [[Badlands II]]
**[[Necrotic Skeleton/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Skeleton]], an enemy that is spawned by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]], that first appears on Wave 6 in [[Badlands II]]
**[[Skeleton/Advanced Stats]]

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)]], a high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 27 in [[Blind Faith]]
**[[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Giant Skeleton (Lunar Overture)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 9 in [[The Haunted Past]]
*[[Skeleton (Lunar Overture)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 2 in [[The Haunted Past]]
**[[Skeleton (Lunar Overture)/Advanced Stats]]

==Units==
'''Skeleton''' may refer to these units:
*[[Executioner Skeleton]], a ranged unit that throws a recursive axe spawned by the Level 4 [[Necromancer]]  from Level 3 gravestones
**[[Executioner Skeleton/Gallery]]
*[[Giant Skeleton (Unit)]], a collision-based unit spawned by the Level 3+ [[Necromancer]] from Level 2 gravestones
*[[Giant Skeleton (Unit)/Gallery]]
*[[Skeleton Knight]], a melee-based unit spawned by the Level 3+ [[Necromancer]] from Level 2-3 gravestones
**[[Skeleton Knight/Gallery]]
*[[Skeleton (Unit)]], a collision-based unit spawned by the Level 0+ [[Necromancer]] from Level 1-2 gravestones
**[[Skeleton (Unit)/Gallery]]
*[[Sword Skeleton]], a melee-based unit spawned by the Level 2+ [[Necromancer]] from Level 1 gravestones
**[[Sword Skeleton/Gallery]]
